CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 20.02.2023 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing for FIR No. 110/2019 registered at Bhajan Pura under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide settlement agreement dated 18th November, 2021 which is on record of this Court.
Petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 (complainant) are present in Court and are duly identified by their counsels and the Investigating Officer.

2. Petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 were married on 26th December, 2017 but due to disputes and differences the marriage ended in divorce vide decree dated 4th July, 2022 which is also on record of this Court.
No child was born out of wedlock.
3. As per settlement balance amount of Rs.4 lacs is being tendered by DD No. 684596 drawn on Canara Bank dated 17th February, 2023 to the respondent No. 2 who has duly received and acknowledged.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No. 110/2019 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Bhajan Pura and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
5. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
